author: bardic-inspiration
name: Shadowsilk Studded Coat
summary: Studded leather that lets you step through shadows and vanish.
description: Woven by a hand that has never been seen, and cut to fit no one in particular. It always seems darker than it ought to be.

stats.effect: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. As a Bonus Action, you can step from a dim or dark space you can see to another such space within 60 feet, as if by the *Misty Step* spell. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
